subject: Money-mapping: new stage definitions + quick actions for CRM
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, sales-managers@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Money-mapping: new stage definitions + quick actions for CRM

Hi all,

Heads up — finance and RevOps have finalized a small set of changes to our forecast categories and stage mappings. These are targeted tweaks (not a full taxonomy rewrite) but they matter for Q3 planning and our commit reviews. Please read and act within 48 hours.

What changed (TL;DR):
- Commit: deals with an approved buying plan, active executive sponsor, and realistic close date within the next 60 days. Commit now excludes opportunities still awaiting legal/PO unless finance has pre-approved the vendor terms.
- Best Case: opportunities with strong interest and an identified economic buyer but without an exec sponsor or where procurement/contracting is in early review. Window: 120 days max.
- Pipeline: all other active opportunities and nurture-stage prospects; treat as upside.

Why: Cleaner Commit = more predictable revenue and fewer post-period true-ups. This helps us with quota, capacity planning, and any external guidance.

Immediate asks (short checklist):
1) Run a CRM filter for deals > $25k and confirm stage mapping matches the new rules. Update the stage tag if not.
2) Add a short note on each changed opportunity: reason for remap and the owner who updated it.
3) For any deal you believe should remain Commit despite a missing exec sponsor, add a one-line justification and loop in finance@redwood.com.
4) Sign up for one of the 30-minute training slots next week (see times below).

Attachments: 20270503-money-mapping-onepager.pdf (one-pager summary) and crm-stage-update-checklist.md (step-by-step). Also linked: SUP-1212 for the ticketed rollout.

Training slots (pick one):
- Tue 5/4 09:00-09:30 PT
- Tue 5/4 12:00-12:30 PT
- Wed 5/5 16:00-16:30 PT

If you already run a regional commit review, please incorporate the new language into your agenda and bring an anonymized example.

Thanks — this should shave a few noisy adjustments off month-end.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses — summary and next steps below.

Summary of confirmations:
- Commit floor: $25k company-wide for this rollout. Finance will revisit for FY28.
- Best Case window: set to 120 days for now (see SUP-1212 notes).
- Procurement-hold + finance pre-approval: can be treated as Commit when finance explicitly signs off; include the approval ticket in CRM notes.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: share the filtered export with remap_reason and remap_owner columns by Thu 5/6 EOD.
- Vivek: run APAC region filter and flag any enterprise deals that need executive alignment; add one-line justification for each remap.
- All sales managers: update stage tags for any deals you touch within 48 hours and add a note.

Training reminders: Tue 5/4 09:00 PT (recording will be available), Tue 5/4 12:00 PT (confirmed), Wed 5/5 16:00 PT. Recording/link will be posted here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_fake_drive_link_money_mapping

If anyone needs an exception (e.g., deal > $250k that you want to keep in Best Case for strategic reasons), send a two-line justification to finance@redwood.com and cc me. We'll handle exceptions in the weekly commit review.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marissa Cole
